subject: financial_literacy
concept: Applying saving, spending, comparing prices, giving, and allowance-planning to a real-world scenario using the student's interest profile
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student plans a full simple allowance cycle: earning, dividing spend/save/give, and reaching a small goal
exercise.abstract: Student explains their plan in a short spoken or written response

assessment.mastery_threshold: plan is internally consistent and reflects a realistic allocation across all categories
misconception_flags: plan's numbers don't add up correctly across the stated categories

interest_binding: scenario generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
